data.narrative:
Dream Security, a Series B defense and security company founded by Shalev Hulio, Sebastian Kurz, and Gil Dolev, is valued at $3.0B post-money following $100M+ in cumulative fundraising. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms in the same sector and stage, including Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), and Heven AeroTech ($1.0B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology applied a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier to the $3.0B base valuation, yielding $5.7B. Peer-median analysis across the 6 sampled same-stage, same-sector comparables produced a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $1.4B, materially below the current ask.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $850M to $6.6B, with a median implied value of $3.4B. The $3.0B current valuation sits at the median, supported primarily by stage-progression logic but substantially above peer median multiples. Key uncertainty centers on whether Dream Security commands a premium to sector peers justified by differentiated technology or market position—information not present in valuation inputs alone.
